(त॑-था, correlative of य॑-था, Pāṇ. v, 3, 26; g. चादि, Kāś. and, Gaṇar.) in that manner, so, thus (the correlative standing in the preceding or in the subsequent clause, e.g. यथा प्रियं, तथास्तु, ‘as is agreeable, so let it be’; तथा प्रयत्नम् आतिष्ठेद् यथात्मानं न पीडयेत्, ‘he should so make effort as that he may not injure himself.’ Mn. vii, 68; तथा तथा-यथा, so much that, VP. iv; also correlative of इव, Mn. iii, 181; R. i, 4, 12; of येन, Kathās. iii, 18; of यादृश, Mn. i, 42; used in forms of adjuration e.g. यथाहम् अन्यं न चिन्तये तथायम् पततां क्षुद्रः परासुः, ‘as surely as I do not think on any other man, so surely let this wretch fall dead’ Nal. xi, 36), RV. &c.
yes, so be it, so it shall be (particle of assent, agreement, or promise; generally followed by इति), AV. iii, 4, 5; ŚBr.; AitBr. &c. (तथेत्य् उक्त्वा, having said ‘so be it’ or ‘yes’ Nal. &c.)
so also, in like manner (e.g. सुखं सेवेद् दुःखं तथा, ‘let him make use of prosperity and also adversity’), Mn.; MBh. &c.
त॑°था च and likewise, accordingly (introducing quotations), Mn. ix, 19 and 45; Dhūrtas.; Hit.
त॑°थापि even thus, even so, nevertheless, yet, still, notwithstanding (correlative of यद्य् अपि [R. iii, 3, 3; Dhūrtas. &c.], अपि [Amar.], अपि यदि [Prab.], कामम् [Śak.], वरम्), MBh. &c.
त॑°था हि (g. स्वर्-आदि) for so, for thus (it has been said), for instance, Ragh.; Śak. &c.
त॑°थैव exactly so, in like manner, Mn. &c.
त॑°थैव (with च or अपि following) likewise, Mn. &c.
यथा तथा in whatever way, in any way, by all means, iv, 17; MBh. i, 45, 17; vii, 6332; Nal.; Naiṣ. ix, 29
यथा यथा — तथा तथा in whatever manner or degree-in that manner or degree the more-the more, Mn.; MBh. (Nal. viii, 14), VarBṛS. xi; Vet.
यथा यथा — तथा तथा cf. यथा-तथम्, अ- and वि-तथ.
तथाकरण: त॑था—करण n. proceeding thus, ĀpŚr. xi, 21, 8 Sch. (अ- neg.)
तथाकारम्: त॑था—कारम् ind. thus (correlative of यथ्°), Pāṇ. iii, 4, 28.
तथाकृत: त॑था—कृत mfn. thus done or made, W.
तथाक्रतु: त॑था—क्रतु (त॑थ्°) mfn. so intending, ŚBr. xiv, 7, 2, 7.
तथागत: त॑था—गत mfn. being in such a state or condition, of such a quality or nature, RPrāt. iii, 5; MBh.; Mālav. v, 9/10
‘he who comes and goes in the same way [as the Buddhas who preceded him]’, Gautama Buddha, Buddh.; Sarvad.
तथागतकोशपरिपालिता: त॑था—गत—कोश-परिपालिता f. N. of a Kiṃnara virgin, Kāraṇḍ. i, 83
तथागतगर्भ: त॑था—गत—गर्भ m. N. of a Bodhi-sattva, Buddh.; L.
तथागतगुणज्ञानाचिन्त्यविषयावतारनिर्देश: त॑था—गत—गुण-ज्ञानाचिन्त्य-विषयावतार-निर्देश m. ‘direction how to attain to the inconceivable subject of the Tathā-gata's qualities and knowledge’, N. of a Buddh. Sūtra
तथागतगुह्यक: त॑था—गत—गुह्यक n. ‘Tathāgata-mystery’, N. of a Buddh. wk. (highly revered in Nepāl)
तथागतभद्र: त॑था—गत—भद्र m. N. of a pupil of Nāgârjuna.
तथागुण: त॑था—गुण mf(आ)n. endowed with such qualities, R. ii, 22, 19.
तथाजातीयक: त॑था—जातीयक mfn. id., Pat. on Śivas. 3 f., Vārtt. 5.
तथाता: त॑था—ता f. true state of things, true nature, Vajracch. 17.
तथात्व: त॑था—त्व n. the being so, such a state of things, such a condition, Bhāṣāp.; Sāh. vii, 8/9; Sarvad.
तथाप्रभाव: त॑था—प्रभाव mfn. having such power, R. ii, 22, 30.
तथाभवितव्यता: त॑था—भवितव्य-ता f. the necessity of being so, Kād. iv, 139.
तथाभाव: त॑था—भाव m. the being so, TPrāt. Sch.
the being of such a nature, true nature, accomplishment, Jain.; Siṉhâs.
तथाभाविन्: त॑था—भाविन् mfn. about to be of such a kind, Śak. vii, 32/33.
तथाभूत: त॑था—भूत mfn. of such qualities or kind or nature, R. i f.; Amar.; Kathās.; Sāh.
तथामुख: त॑था—मुख mfn. ‘so-facing’, turning the face in the same direction, Gobh. iv, 2, 5.
तथायतम्: त॑था°यतम् (°थाय्°) ind. in the same direction, 4.
तथाराज: त॑था—राज m. a Buddha (cf. -गत) or Jina, W.
तथारूप: त॑था—रूप mf(आ)n. so formed, thus shaped, looking thus, Lāṭy., ix, 12; MBh. &c.
तथार्थत्व: त॑था—°र्थ—त्व n. the being real, BṛĀrUp. Sch.
तथावादिन्: त॑था—वादिन् mfn. telling the exact truth, Viṣṇ. v, 27; Vajracch. 14
तथाविध: त॑था—विध mf(आ)n. (त॑थ्°) of such a sort or kind, being in such a condition or state, of such qualities, TBr. ii, 1, 10, 1; Mn. i, viii f. (correlative of यादृश, ix, 9), MBh. &c.
तथाविधम्: त॑था—विधम् ind. in this manner, Nal. vii, 15
तथाविधान: त॑था—विधान mfn. following this practice, Hit. iii, 9, 6/1.
तथावीर्य: त॑था—वीर्य mfn. of such a strength, MBh. i.
तथाशील: त॑था—शील mfn. behaving thus, MBh. iv, 133
तथाशीलसमाचार: त॑था—शील—समाचार mfn. of such a character and behaviour, v, 73, 14
तथास्वर: त॑था—स्वर mfn. uttered with the same accent, Lāṭy. vii, 10, 20.
तथोत्साह: तथोत्साह mfn. making so great efforts, W.
तथोपम: तथोपम mfn. similar to that, MBh. xii, 285 ff.
तथ्य: तथ्य mfn. ‘being really so’, true, MBh.; R.; Pañcat.
तथ्येन: तथ्येन ind. according to truth, Mn. viii, 274.
तथ्यवचन: तथ्य—वचन n. a promise, Pañcat. Introd. 10/11,
तथ्यवादिन्: तथ्य—वादिन् mfn. speaking the truth, BhP. viii, 11, 11.
तद्: त॑द् (nom. and acc. sg. n. of and base in comp. for 2. त॑ from which latter all the cases of this pron. are formed except nom. sg. m. स॑स् or स॑ & f. सा॑; instr. pl. तै॑स्, AV. &c.; Ved. ते॑भिस्, RV.; AV. &c.) m. he f. she n. it, that, this (often correlative of य॑ generally standing in the preceding clause e.g. यस्य बुद्धिः स बलवान्, ‘of whom there is intellect he is strong’; sometimes, for the sake of emphasis, connected with the 1st and 2nd personal pronouns, with other demonstratives and with relatives e.g. सो ऽहम्, ‘I that very person, I myself’ [तस्य = मम, Nal. xv, 10]; ताव् इमौ, ‘those very two’; तद् एतद् आख्यानम्, ‘that very tale’ AitBr. vii, 18; यत् तत् कारणम्, ‘that very reason which’ Mn. i, 11; या सा श्री, ‘that very fortune which’ MBh. vii, 427), RV. &c.
त॑द् (तद्) n. this world (cf. इदम्), R. vi, 102, 25
त॑द् (त॑द्) ind. there, in that place, thither, to that spot (correlative of य॑त्र or य॑तस्), AV.; AitBr. ii, 11; ŚBr. i, x, xiv; ChUp.
त॑द् ind. then, at that time, in that case (correlative of यदा॑, य॑द्, AV.; of य॑त्र, ŚBr. xiv; of यदि, Nal.; Bhag. &c.; of चेद्, Śak. &c.), RV. iv, 28, 1; AV. &c.
thus, in this manner, with regard to that, ix, xiii; ŚBr.; AitBr.
(तद् एतौ श्लोकौ भवतः, ‘with reference to that there are these two verses’), PraśnUp.
on that account, for that reason, therefore, consequently (sometimes correlative of यतस्, यद्, येन, ‘because’ Daś.; Pañcat.; Kathās. &c.), Mn. ix, 41; MBh. &c.
now (clause-connecting particle), AV. xv; ŚBr.; AitBr.
so also, equally, and, AV. xi, xv
तद् तद् तद् this and that, various, different (e.g. तं तं देशं जगाम, ‘he went to this and that place’; तासु तासु योनिषु, ‘in different or various birth-places’ Mn. xii, 74)
तद् तद् तद् respective, BṛNārP. xiii, 88
तद् तेनैव तेनैव पथा, on quite the same path, R. iii, 50, 28

तद् यद् तद् whosoever, whichsoever, any, every (also with वा, Mn. xii, 68 [यद् वा तद् वा, ‘this or that, any’] Hariv. 5940; Dhūrtas.; Śak. Sch.; often both pronouns repeated or the interrogative pron. with चिद् added after the relative e.g. यद्-यत् पर-वशं कर्म तत्-तद् वर्जयेत्, ‘whatever action depends on another, that he should avoid’ Mn. iv, 159; यत् किं-चिद्-तद्, ‘whatever-that’ Mn.)
तद् तन् न See s.v. चेद्
तद् तद् ind. अपि ‘even then’, nevertheless, notwithstanding, Śak. (v.l.), Bhartṛ.; Prab.; Siṉhâs.
तद् तद् (ind.) यथा ‘in such a manner as follows’, namely, viz. Buddh. (cf. Pāli seyyathā; स॑ य॑था-, ŚBr.), Jain. (in Prākṛt taṃ jahā; cf. सेज्जहा), Pat.; Śak.
तद् [cf. ὁ, ἡ, τό; Goth. sa, so, that-a; Lat. (is-) te, (is-) ta, (is-) tud, tam, tum, tunc.]
तदनन्तर: त॑द्—अनन्तर mf(आ)n. nearest to any one (gen.), Nal. xxii, 16
तदनन्तरम्: त॑द्—अनन्तरम् ind. immediately upon that, thereupon, then (corresponding to प्राक्, ‘before’ Śak. vii, 30; to प्रथमम्, ‘first’ Mn. viii, 129), MBh. &c.
तदनु: त॑द्—अनु ind. after that, afterwards, Megh.; Ratnâv.; Amar.; Śrut.; Subh.
तदनुकृति: त॑द्—अनुकृति ind. conformably to that, accordingly, AitBr. vi, 1, 2.
तदनुसरण: त॑द्—अनुसरण n. going after that, Sāh. i, 2/3, 58
तदनुसरणक्रमेण: त॑द्—अनुसरण—क्रमेण ind. instr. See s.v. क्र॑म.
तदन्त: त॑द्—अन्त (त॑द्-) mfn. coming to an end by that, TBr. i, 5, 9, 3; Hit.
तदन्न: त॑द्—अन्न mfn. (त॑द्-) accustomed to that food, RV. viii, 47, 16
eating (that i.e.) the same food, R. ii, 103, 30 and 140, 13.
तदन्य: त॑द्—अन्य mfn. other than that, L.
तदन्वय: त॑द्—अन्वय mfn. descended from him, VP. iv, 2, 2.
तदपत्य: त॑द्—अपत्य mfn. having offspring from him, Mn. iii, 16 (-ता f. abstr.)
तदपत्यमय: त॑द्—अपत्य—मय mfn. thinking of one's off spring only, Subh.
तदपस्: त॑द्—अपस् mfn. (त॑द्-) accustomed to that work or to do that, RV. ii, 13, 3 and 38, 1; viii, 47, 16
त॑द्—अपस् ind. in the usual way, v, 47, 2.
तदपेक्ष: त॑द्—अपेक्ष mfn. having regard to that, Gaut.
तदर्थ: त॑द्—अर्थ mfn. intended for that, Āp. ii, 14, 3; Pāṇ. ii, 1, 36; i, 3, 72; Kāś.
serving for that, Jaim. i, 2, 1 (अ- neg.)
having that or the same meaning, Pāṇ. ii, 3, 58
त॑द्—अर्थ m. (its or) their meaning, Vedântas. 200
तदर्थम्: त॑द्—अर्थम् ind. on that account, with that object, for that end, therefore, Pāṇ. v, 1, 12; R. i, 73, 4; VarBṛS. lxxiv; Kāś.; VP. iv
तदर्थता: त॑द्—अर्थ—ता f. = तादर्थ्य, ĀśvŚr. iii, 4, 12 Sch.
तदर्थक: त॑द्—अर्थक mf(इका)n. denoting that, Naiṣ. iv, 52.
तदर्थीय: त॑द्—°अर्थीय mfn. intended for that, undertaken for that end, Bhag. xvii, 27.
तदर्धिक: त॑द्—°अर्धिक mfn. half as much, Mn. iii, 1.
तदर्पण: त॑द्—अर्पण n. delivery of that, W.
तदवधि: त॑द्—अवधि ind. from that time, Bhām. ii, 56
तदवस्थ: त॑द्—अवस्थ mfn. so situated, thus circumstanced, in that condition, MBh. iii, 69, 31; Ratnâv.
being in the same condition (as before), undamaged, iv, 19.
तदहे: त॑द्—अहे loc. ind. on that day, Hemac.
तदाकार: त॑द्—आकार mfn. having that appearance, W.
तदाकारपरिज्ञान: त॑द्—आकार—परिज्ञान n. N. of an art, Gal.
तदात्मक: त॑द्—आत्मक mfn. constituting its nature, Car. vi, 12; Sarvad. xv.
तदादि: त॑द्—आदि ind. from that time forward, Śiś. i, 45; Dharmaśarm.
तदामुख: त॑द्—आमुख n. beginning of that, L.
तदिदर्थ: त॑द्—इ॑द्-अर्थ mfn. intent on that particular object, RV. viii, 2, 16 (cf. ii, 39, 1; ix, 1, 5; x, 106, 1).
तदिदासीय: त॑द्—इद्-आसीय n. the hymn, RV. x, 120; ŚāṅkhŚr. xi.
तदिष्टि: त॑द्—इष्टि (त॑द्-) mfn. accompanied by such offerings, AV. xi, 7, 19.
तदेकचित्त: त॑द्—एक-चित्त mfn. having all the thoughts fixed on that (person or thing), Hit.
तदेवोपनिषद्: त॑द्—एवोपनिषद् f. N. of an, Up. (beginning with the words तद् एव).
तदोकस्: त॑द्—ओकस् (त॑द्-) mfn. rejoicing in that, RV. i, 15, 1; iii, 35, 7; iv, 49, 6; vii, 29, 1.
तदोजस्: त॑द्—ओजस् (त॑द्-) mfn. endowed with such strength, v, 1, 8.
तद्गत: त॑द्—गत mfn. directed towards him or her or them or that, R. i f.; Kathās. iii, 68
त॑द्—गत m. (?) the continued multiplication of 4 or more like quantities, W.
तद्गुण: त॑द्—गुण mfn. possessing these qualities, KātyŚr. xiv f.
त॑द्—गुण m. the quality of that or those, xii f.
the virtue of (that or) those (persons), Ragh. i, 9
(in rhet.) transferring the qualities of one thing to another (a figure of speech), Sāh. x, 90; Kuval.; Kpr. x, 51
also अ- neg. ‘a figure of speech in which a quality expected in any object is denied’, 52
तद्गुणत्व: त॑द्—गुण—त्व n. the having its qualities, Jaim. vi, 7, 16 (अ- neg.)
तद्गुणसंविज्ञान: त॑द्—गुण—संविज्ञान n. (a Bahuvrīhi compound) in which the qualities implied are perceived along with the thing itself (e.g. दीर्घकर्ण, ‘long-ear’; opposed to अ- e.g. दृष्टसागर, ‘one who has seen the ocean’), Bādar. i, 1, 2 Sch.; Sarvad.
तद्दिनम्: त॑द्—दिनम् ind. on a certain day, W.
तद्दुःख: त॑द्—दुःख n. grief for that or of that, W.
तद्देवत: त॑द्—देवत mfn. having that deity, KātyŚr. xxiv, 6; ĀpŚr. vii; PārGṛ. iii, 11, 10.
तद्देवताक: त॑द्—देवताक mfn. id., RV. x, 18; Sāy.
तद्देश्य: त॑द्—देश्य mfn. coming from the same country, (m.) a fellow-countryman, MBh. xii, 168, 41; Kām. xiii, 77.
तद्दैवत: त॑द्—दैवत mfn. = -देव्°, Nir. vii, 1; PārGṛ. iii, 11, 10.
तद्द्वितीय: त॑द्—द्वितीय mfn. doing that for the 2nd time, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 162; Kāś.
तद्धर्म: तद्-धर्म mfn. having the same qualities, ĀpY.
तद्धर्मन्: accomplishing his business, KātyŚr. i, 6, 12; Jaim. vi, 3, 26 (cf. ताद्धर्म्य)
तद्धर्मत्व: त॑द्—धर्°म-त्व n. the having his or its peculiarity, KapS. i, 52 (अ- neg.)
तद्धर्मिन्: त॑द्—धर्मिन् mfn. obeying his laws, BhP. iii, 15, 32.
तद्धर्म्य: त॑द्—°धर्म्य mfn. of that kind, v, 14, 2.
तद्धारण: त॑द्—धारण n. N. of an art, Gal.
तद्धित: त॑द्—धित n. (हित) sg. and pl. his welfare, Āp. ii; BhP. ii, 9, 7

त॑द्—धित m. (scil. प्रत्यय) an affix forming nouns from other nouns (opposed to 1. कृत्), noun formed thus, derivative noun (तद्-धित mfn. ‘good for that or him’, is one of the meanings peculiar to derivative, nouns cf. मौदकिक &c.), Nir. ii, 2; Prāt.; Pāṇ.; ŚāṅkhGṛ.; PārGṛ.; Gobh. ii, 8, 15 (also अ—त॑द्-धित neg. mfn. ‘having no Taddhita affix’)
तद्धितढुण्ढी: त॑द्—धित—ढुण्ढी f. N. of a gloss on the Taddhita chapter in Hemachandra's grammar by Ānandagaṇi.
तद्बन्धु: त॑द्—बन्धु (त॑द्-) mfn. belonging to that family or race, RV. x, 61, 18.
तद्बल: त॑द्—बल, m. or त॑द्—ब°ला, f. a kind of arrow, L.
तद्बला: त॑द्—बल, m. or त॑द्—ब°ला, f. a kind of arrow, L.
तद्बहु: त॑द्—बहु mfn. doing that often, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 162; Kāś.
तद्भव: त॑द्—भव mfn. = तज्ज, Mn. iv, 232, Medhāt.
तद्भाव: त॑द्—भाव m. the becoming that, KātyŚr. iv, 3, 13; Bādar. iii, 4, 40 (अ- neg., ‘the becoming [not that i.e.] something else’)
तद्भूत: त॑द्—भूत mfn. being in that, Jaim. i, 1, 25.
तद्रस: त॑द्—रस m. the spirit thereof, W.
तद्राज: त॑द्—राज m. (scil. प्रत्यय) an affix added to the N. of a race for forming the N. of its chief, Pāṇ. ii, 4, 62; iv, 1, 174; v, 3, 119.
तद्रूप: त॑द्—रूप mf(आ)n. thus shaped, so formed, looking thus, KapS. v, 19 and; Jaim. vi, 5, 3 (-त्व n. abstr.), Pañcat.; Pāṇ. vii, 3, 86 Sch.
of the same quality, Sarvad. xv, 354; Vām. iv, 3, 9 (अ- neg. ‘of different quality’)
तद्वत्: त॑द्—वत् mfn. having or containing that, VPrāt.; Pāṇ. iv, 4, 125; KapS. i, v; Tarkas. &c.
त॑द्—वत् ind. like that, thus, so (correlative of यद्-वत्, Mn. x, 13; Bhag.; Pañcat.; of यथा, ‘as’ ŚvetUp. ii, 14 [v.l. for तद्-वा] MBh. i, vii &c.), ŚāṅkhGṛ. v, 9, 3 &c.
in like manner, likewise, also, Śrut.; Kathās. vi, xxvi
